searchText: The new gas schedule for verkle tries includes a fix for this broken incentive, making DELEGATECALL a viable architecture without incurring significant gas overhead. > can't you incur a stack overflow via a dynamically-bounded loop? A frequent question. The answer is no, because it breaks the rule that the stack depth is the same on every path through a location in the bytecode. So the validator would reject such a loop.

> can't you incur a stack overflow via a dynamically-bounded loop?
A frequent question.  The answer is no, because it breaks the rule that the stack depth is the same on every path through a location in the bytecode.  So the validator would reject such a loop.
